scope: Exploratory new-physics sandbox, not a claim of research novelty or production HeROsim validation
teacher: best of controls and deterministic anneal8192; feasible reference, not a certified optimum
selection: one hand algorithm per mechanism by calibration mean objective among p95 case-median timing <=2ms; no per-case free hindsight control
shortlist: median paired reference gain >=5pct with bootstrap lower bound >0 and selected hand control screen p95<=2ms
validation: All selected-control, teacher and fastest schedules replay in independent SimPy event simulator on every screen case; baseline-neutrality and mechanism-off ablation; actual-source fingerprints and input uniqueness before simulation
training: No training on this discovery screen. Any survivor needs fresh confirmation, stronger graph/search controls, observability witness and separately registered training/test splits.
information: all job routes, processing times, lock requests, setup classes, cooling graph, domain caps, deadlines, maintenance and tariff calendars announced equally to every arm; no hidden future used
